items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 100:1
items.html: (To the question) That is the male Gevurot that she receives from Ima, by the power of the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach; then she does not need to receive the illumination from the crown of Gevura of ZA, as at the time she is face to face, but she receives the male Gevurot themselves, from Ima, as said in Answers 6 and 7, see there. (Item 118).
